title: 特朗普：不想当胡佛 伊朗核谈或引发大萧条
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Can you be sure that the Iranians won't use profits from oil sales to rebuild their military?
segments.zh: 你能确定伊朗不会用石油销售利润重建军队吗？

segments.en: Well, they're not supposed to be doing that, so we'll say, but they're supposed to use money to buy food for their people, because right now the people are very hungry, and they're
segments.zh: 他们不应该那样做，应该用钱为人民买食物，因为现在人民很饥饿。

segments.en: buying it exclusively from us to corn, so it means it should be a lot of money, but I hope it's a lot of money.
segments.zh: 他们只从我们这里买玉米，所以应该有很多钱，我希望如此。

segments.en: If there was a Iran that could cause a worldwide depression, as you noted, Mr. President, are you willing to risk economic catastrophe and strike Iran again?
segments.zh: 如果伊朗可能引发全球萧条，您愿意冒经济灾难的风险再次打击伊朗吗？

segments.en: Well, not the way I'm doing it is not going to cause depression, but if they don't abide by them.
segments.zh: 我现在的做法不会导致萧条，除非他们不遵守。

segments.en: Depression is real bad. Nuclear weapons will cause depression much more quickly.
segments.zh: 萧条很糟糕，核武器会更快引发萧条。

segments.en: The way we're doing it, we have the opposite of a depression, we're doing really well.
segments.zh: 我们的做法带来了相反的结果，我们做得很好。

segments.en: The numbers are incredible. The oil is at a level that nobody's ever seen before.
segments.zh: 数字惊人，石油价格处于前所未有的水平。

segments.en: Oil prices are way down. I think they're very comparable to what they were, Chris, I don't know, or pretty comparable to what they were before we started.
segments.zh: 油价大幅下跌，我认为与开始前相当。

segments.en: They've returned most of the way back down. No, so if Iran is not abide by the MOU, are you still willing to risk it?
segments.zh: 它们已经回落了大半。那么，如果伊朗不遵守谅解备忘录，你仍然愿意冒险吗？

segments.en: What I just say is that it could cause a depression. I said, it could cause a depression, right, and they said that I don't want to be Herbert
segments.zh: 我刚才说的是，这可能导致经济萧条。我说了，可能导致经济萧条，对吧，他们说我可不想成为赫伯特

segments.en: Hoover, that's the president that I don't want to pay, because he was in charge during the Great Depression, and certainly a lot of bad things could happen.
segments.zh: 胡佛，那是我最不想成为的总统，因为他执政期间发生了大萧条，当然很多坏事都可能发生。
